chats.answer:
The best solar panel-to-power station cable depends on your solar panel connectors and your power station's solar input port.

For most setups, I recommend a 10 AWG pure copper solar extension cable with MC4 connectors. It's durable, weather-resistant, and reduces power loss compared with thinner cables, especially over longer distances.
